stageA.sourceMathematics: Each printed clock number is a jump of5 minutes. Minute hand on1 means05, on6 means30, on8 means40, on11 means55; advancing minutes moves hour hand gradually toward next hour.
stageA.studentFacingAuthenticTask: Original Activity1 compare TWO ways to read one actual clock, organize publisher analog CLOCK CARDS by chronological time, talk about the hour hand approaching9. Activity2 write displayed source clock times, including3:05 with leading0 minutes.
stageA.originalMediaAndHumanLimits: Teacher checks actual visible hands and clock cards, source chronological ordering and student readings; image-only time not guessed.
